# Ireland Birth Rates 1980 to 2018

## Set the import website and read in the Ireland dataset and tidy the dataset

```{r get_Ireland_Data}
raw_births <- cso_get_data("DHA10")

nm = c("North Tipperary", "South Tipperary")

where_births <- raw_births[(raw_births$Statistic %in% "Births") & 
                             (raw_births$Martial.Status.of.Mother%in% "All marital status") &
                             (raw_births$Sex.of.Infant%in% "Both sexes"), ] 

where_births$Area.of.Residence.of.Mother <- as.character(where_births$Area.of.Residence.of.Mother)
where_births$Area.of.Residence.of.Mother <- ifelse(where_births$Area.of.Residence.of.Mother %in% c("North Tipperary", "South Tipperary"), "Tipperary", ifelse(where_births$Area.of.Residence.of.Mother %in% "Dublin City and County", "Dublin", ifelse(where_births$Area.of.Residence.of.Mother %in% "All counties and regions", "All", where_births$Area.of.Residence.of.Mother)) )

where_births$county <- where_births$Area.of.Residence.of.Mother

Births_long<- where_births %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = '1980':'2018',
               names_to = "Year",
               values_to = "Births") %>%
  select(c(county, Age.Group.of.Mother, Births, Year))

Tot_Births <- Births_long[(Births_long$Age.Group.of.Mother %in% "All ages") , ]

Not_Tot_Births <- Births_long[!(Births_long$Age.Group.of.Mother %in% "All ages") , ]

Group_births <- Not_Tot_Births %>%
  group_by(county, Year) %>%
  summarise(Births = sum(Births, na.rm=T))
  
County_wide <- Group_births %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = county,
              values_from = Births)

County_wide$Not_Kerry <- County_wide$All - County_wide$Kerry
County_wide$Not_Offaly <- County_wide$All - County_wide$Offaly
County_wide$Not_Dublin <- County_wide$All - County_wide$Dublin
County_wide$Not_Meath <- County_wide$All - County_wide$Meath
County_wide$Not_Cork <- County_wide$All - County_wide$Cork
County_wide$Not_Donegal <- County_wide$All - County_wide$Donegal
County_wide$Not_Galway <- County_wide$All - County_wide$Galway
County_wide$Not_Tipperary <- County_wide$All - County_wide$Tipperary
County_wide$Not_Kilkenny <- County_wide$All - County_wide$Kilkenny
County_wide$Not_Wexford <- County_wide$All - County_wide$Wexford
County_wide$Not_Clare <- County_wide$All - County_wide$Clare


```

## Create the dataframe with the winners

```{r create_winners}
winnersf <- data.frame(
  year = 1979:2017,
  Winner_football = c("Kerry", "Kerry", "Kerry", "Offaly", "Dublin", "Kerry", "Kerry", "Kerry", "Meath", "Meath", "Cork", "Cork", "Down", "Donegal", "Derry", "Down", "Dublin", "Meath", "Kerry", "Galway","Meath", "Kerry", "Galway","Armagh","Tyrone","Kerry", "Tyrone","Kerry", "Kerry", "Tyrone","Kerry", "Cork", "Dublin", "Donegal", "Dublin", "Kerry", "Dublin", "Dublin", "Dublin"),
  F_Time_since_last_win = c(1978, 1979, 1980, 1972, 1977, 1981, 1984, 1985, 1967, 1987, 1973, 1989, 1968, 1884, 1884, 1991, 1983, 1988, 1986, 1966, 1988, 1997, 1998, 1884, 1884, 2000, 2003, 2004, 2006, 2005, 2007, 1990, 1995, 1992, 2011, 2009, 2013, 2015, 2016 ))

winnersh <- data.frame(
  year = 2017:1979,
  Winner_hurling = c("Galway", "Tipperary", "Kilkenny", "Kilkenny", "Clare", "Kilkenny", "Kilkenny", "Tipperary", "Kilkenny", "Kilkenny", "Kilkenny", "Kilkenny", "Cork", "Cork", "Kilkenny", "Kilkenny", "Tipperary", "Kilkenny", "Cork", "Offaly", "Clare", "Wexford", "Clare", "Offaly", "Kilkenny", "Kilkenny", "Tipperary", "Cork", "Tipperary", "Galway", "Galway", "Cork", "Offaly", "Cork", "Kilkenny", "Kilkenny", "Offaly", "Galway", "Kilkenny"),
 H_Time_since_last_win = c(1988, 2010, 2014, 2012, 1997, 2011, 2009, 2001, 2008, 2007, 2006, 2003, 2004, 1999, 2002, 2000, 1991, 1993, 1990, 1994, 1995, 1968, 1914, 1985, 1992, 1983, 1989, 1986, 1971, 1987, 1980, 1984, 1981, 1978, 1982, 1979, 1884, 1923, 1975)
)

winners <- merge(x=winnersf,  y =winnersh, by = "year", all= TRUE)

winners$rel_year <- winners$year +1 

```

## Import the CSV for the Northern Ireland Births

```{r Import_NI}
NI_births <- read.csv("NI_Data_Upload.csv")

NI_births$Not_Derry <- NI_births$All.Live.Births - NI_births$Derry
NI_births$Not_Tyrone <- NI_births$All.Live.Births - NI_births$Tyrone
NI_births$Not_Armagh <- NI_births$All.Live.Births - NI_births$Armagh
NI_births$Not_Down <- NI_births$All.Live.Births - NI_births$Down

```

## Modelling time Ireland Set

```{r Modelling_Ireland}
Kerry_mod <- lm(Kerry ~ Not_Kerry + Cork + Limerick, data= County_wide_Kerry)
Offaly_mod <- lm(Offaly ~ Not_Offaly + Laois + Westmeath, data= County_wide_Offaly)
Dublin_mod <- lm(Dublin ~ Not_Dublin + Meath + Kildare, data= County_wide_Dublin)
Meath_mod <- lm(Meath ~ Not_Meath + Dublin + Kildare, data= County_wide_Meath)
Cork_mod <- lm(Cork ~ Not_Cork + Kerry + Limerick, data= County_wide_Cork)
Donegal_mod <- lm(Donegal ~ Not_Donegal + Sligo + Leitrim, data= County_wide_Donegal)
Galway_mod <- lm(Galway ~ Not_Galway + Mayo + Clare, data= County_wide_Galway)
Tipperary_mod <- lm(Tipperary ~ Not_Tipperary + Kilkenny + Limerick, data= County_wide_Tipperary)
Kilkenny_mod <- lm(Kilkenny ~ Not_Kilkenny + Tipperary + Waterford, data= County_wide_Kilkenny)
Wexford_mod <- lm(Wexford ~ Not_Wexford + Kilkenny + Waterford, data= County_wide_Wexford)
Clare_mod <- lm(Clare ~ Not_Clare + Galway + Limerick, data= County_wide_Clare)

Tyrone_mod <- lm(Tyrone ~ Belfast + South.Eastern, data= County_wide_Tyrone)
Derry_mod <- lm(Derry ~ Belfast + South.Eastern + Southern , data= County_wide_Derry)
Armagh_mod <- lm(Armagh ~ Northern + South.Eastern + Western, data= County_wide_Armagh)
Down_mod <- lm(Down ~ Northern + Belfast + Western , data= County_wide_Down)

Kerry_stats <- summary(Kerry_mod)
Offaly_stats <- summary(Offaly_mod)
Dublin_stats <- summary(Dublin_mod)
Meath_stats <- summary(Meath_mod)
Cork_stats <- summary(Cork_mod)
Donegal_stats <- summary(Donegal_mod)
Galway_stats <- summary(Galway_mod)
Tipperary_stats <- summary(Tipperary_mod)
Kilkenny_stats <- summary(Kilkenny_mod)
Wexford_stats <- summary(Wexford_mod)
Clare_stats <- summary(Clare_mod)

Tyrone_stats <- summary(Tyrone_mod)
Derry_stats <- summary(Derry_mod)
Armagh_stats <- summary(Armagh_mod)
Down_stats <- summary(Down_mod)

WCounty_wide_Kerry$pred <- predict(Kerry_mod, WCounty_wide_Kerry)
WCounty_wide_Offaly$pred <- predict(Offaly_mod, WCounty_wide_Offaly)
WCounty_wide_Dublin$pred <- predict(Dublin_mod, WCounty_wide_Dublin)
WCounty_wide_Meath$pred <- predict(Meath_mod, WCounty_wide_Meath)
WCounty_wide_Cork$pred <- predict(Cork_mod, WCounty_wide_Cork)
WCounty_wide_Donegal$pred <- predict(Donegal_mod, WCounty_wide_Donegal)
WCounty_wide_Galway$pred <- predict(Galway_mod, WCounty_wide_Galway)
WCounty_wide_Tipperary$pred <- predict(Tipperary_mod, WCounty_wide_Tipperary)
WCounty_wide_Kilkenny$pred <- predict(Kilkenny_mod, WCounty_wide_Kilkenny)
WCounty_wide_Wexford$pred <- predict(Wexford_mod, WCounty_wide_Wexford)
WCounty_wide_Clare$pred <- predict(Clare_mod, WCounty_wide_Clare)

WCounty_wide_Tyrone$pred <- predict(Tyrone_mod, WCounty_wide_Tyrone)
WCounty_wide_Derry$pred <- predict(Derry_mod, WCounty_wide_Derry)
WCounty_wide_Armagh$pred <- predict(Armagh_mod, WCounty_wide_Armagh)
WCounty_wide_Down$pred <- predict(Down_mod, WCounty_wide_Down)

WCounty_wide_Kerry$standif <- (WCounty_wide_Kerry$Kerry - WCounty_wide_Kerry$pred)/Kerry_stats$sigma
WCounty_wide_Offaly$standif <- (WCounty_wide_Offaly$Offaly - WCounty_wide_Offaly$pred)/Offaly_stats$sigma
WCounty_wide_Dublin$standif <- (WCounty_wide_Dublin$Dublin - WCounty_wide_Dublin$pred)/Dublin_stats$sigma
WCounty_wide_Meath$standif <- (WCounty_wide_Meath$Meath - WCounty_wide_Meath$pred)/Meath_stats$sigma
WCounty_wide_Cork$standif <- (WCounty_wide_Cork$Cork - WCounty_wide_Cork$pred)/Cork_stats$sigma
WCounty_wide_Donegal$standif <- (WCounty_wide_Donegal$Donegal - WCounty_wide_Donegal$pred)/Donegal_stats$sigma
WCounty_wide_Galway$standif <- (WCounty_wide_Galway$Galway - WCounty_wide_Galway$pred)/Galway_stats$sigma
WCounty_wide_Tipperary$standif <- (WCounty_wide_Tipperary$Tipperary - WCounty_wide_Tipperary$pred)/ Tipperary_stats$sigma
WCounty_wide_Kilkenny$standif <- (WCounty_wide_Kilkenny$Kilkenny - WCounty_wide_Kilkenny$pred)/Kilkenny_stats$sigma
WCounty_wide_Wexford$standif <- (WCounty_wide_Wexford$Wexford - WCounty_wide_Wexford$pred)/Wexford_stats$sigma
WCounty_wide_Clare$standif <- (WCounty_wide_Clare$Clare - WCounty_wide_Clare$pred)/Clare_stats$sigma

WCounty_wide_Tyrone$standif <- (WCounty_wide_Tyrone$Tyrone - WCounty_wide_Tyrone$pred)/Tyrone_stats$sigma
WCounty_wide_Derry$standif <- (WCounty_wide_Derry$Derry - WCounty_wide_Derry$pred)/Derry_stats$sigma
WCounty_wide_Armagh$standif <- (WCounty_wide_Armagh$Armagh - WCounty_wide_Armagh$pred)/Armagh_stats$sigma
WCounty_wide_Down$standif <- (WCounty_wide_Down$Down - WCounty_wide_Down$pred)/Down_stats$sigma

WCounty_wide_Tyrone$Year <- WCounty_wide_Tyrone$Registration.Year 
WCounty_wide_Derry$Year <- WCounty_wide_Derry$Registration.Year 
WCounty_wide_Armagh$Year <- WCounty_wide_Armagh$Registration.Year  
WCounty_wide_Down$Year <- WCounty_wide_Down$Registration.Year 

WCounty_wide_Kerry$FH <- "F"
WCounty_wide_Offaly$FH <-  ifelse(WCounty_wide_Offaly$Year == 1983 , "F", "H")
WCounty_wide_Dublin$FH <- "F"
WCounty_wide_Meath$FH <- "F"
WCounty_wide_Cork$FH <- ifelse(WCounty_wide_Cork$Year == 1990 | WCounty_wide_Cork$Year == 1991| WCounty_wide_Cork$Year == 2011, "F", "H")
WCounty_wide_Donegal$FH <- "F"
WCounty_wide_Galway$FH <- ifelse(WCounty_wide_Galway$Year == 1999|WCounty_wide_Galway$Year == 2002, "F", "H")
WCounty_wide_Tipperary$FH <- "H"
WCounty_wide_Kilkenny$FH <- "H"
WCounty_wide_Wexford$FH <- "H"
WCounty_wide_Clare$FH <- "H"
WCounty_wide_Tyrone$FH <- "F"
WCounty_wide_Derry$FH <- "F"
WCounty_wide_Armagh$FH <- "F"
WCounty_wide_Down$FH <- "F"



All_results <- rbind.fill(WCounty_wide_Clare, WCounty_wide_Wexford, WCounty_wide_Kilkenny, WCounty_wide_Tipperary, WCounty_wide_Galway, WCounty_wide_Donegal, WCounty_wide_Cork, WCounty_wide_Meath, WCounty_wide_Dublin, WCounty_wide_Offaly, WCounty_wide_Kerry, WCounty_wide_Tyrone, WCounty_wide_Derry, WCounty_wide_Armagh, WCounty_wide_Down)

All_mean <- mean(All_results$standif)
All_sd <- sd(All_results$standif)
All_len <- length(All_results$standif)

All_test <- All_mean/(All_sd/ sqrt(All_len))

NKK <- All_results[!(All_results$Year %in% Kerry_years$rel_year | All_results$Year %in% Kilkenny_years$rel_year), ] %>%
  select("standif")

NKK_mean <- mean(NKK$standif)
NKK_sd <- sd(NKK$standif)
NKK_len <- length(NKK$standif)

NKK_test <- NKK_mean/(NKK_sd/ sqrt(NKK_len))

NotNI <- All_results[(is.na(All_results$Registration.Year)), ] %>%
  select("standif")

NotNI_mean <- mean(NotNI$standif)
NotNI_sd <- sd(NotNI$standif)
NotNI_len <- length(NotNI$standif)

NotNI_test <- NotNI_mean/(NotNI_sd/ sqrt(NotNI_len))

OnlyFoot <- All_results[(All_results$FH == "F"), ]

OnlyFoot$Year[order(OnlyFoot$Year, decreasing = TRUE)]

OnlyFoot_mean <- mean(OnlyFoot$standif)
OnlyFoot_sd <- sd(OnlyFoot$standif)
OnlyFoot_len <- length(OnlyFoot$standif)

OnlyFoot_test <- OnlyFoot_mean/(OnlyFoot_sd/ sqrt(OnlyFoot_len))

OnlyHurl <- rbind.fill(All_results[(All_results$FH == "H"), ], All_results[(All_results$Year == 1991), ])

OnlyHurl_mean <- mean(OnlyHurl$standif)
OnlyHurl_sd <- sd(OnlyHurl$standif)
OnlyHurl_len <- length(OnlyHurl$standif)

OnlyHurl_test <- OnlyHurl_mean/(OnlyHurl_sd/ sqrt(OnlyHurl_len))

famine_f <- winnersf[(winnersf$year - winnersf$F_Time_since_last_win >= 10), ]
famine_f <- famine_f[!(famine_f$Winner_football == "Tyrone" |famine_f$Winner_football == "Down"| famine_f$Winner_football == "Armagh"| famine_f$Winner_football == "Derry"), ]
famine_f$FH = "F"
famine_h <- winnersh[(winnersh$year - winnersh$H_Time_since_last_win >= 10), ]
famine_h$FH = "H"

amine_relief = rbind.fill(famine_h, famine_f)
amine_relief$fam <- paste(amine_relief$year, amine_relief$FH )

All_results$fam <- paste(All_results$Year, All_results$FH )

famine_relief  <- All_results[(All_results$fam %in% amine_relief$fam ), ]

famine_relief_mean <- mean(famine_relief$standif)
famine_relief_sd <- sd(famine_relief$standif)
famine_relief_len <- length(famine_relief$standif)

famine_relief_test <- famine_relief_mean/(famine_relief_sd/ sqrt(famine_relief_len))

```
